name: continuum
description: Continuous work without sessions: memory lives in an Obsidian vault (tasks, decisions, log) read and written through an MCP; a hook without AI records the work. In development.

autocommit.title: Commit the vault after each turn
autocommit.description: After each turn with work, commit the vault's repo (never pushes). Off: only the log line is written. A project can override this in .claude/claude-workbench.conf.

python.title: Python to use
python.description: Path or command of a Python 3.8+ (leave empty to try python3, python and py -3 automatically).
